name: Articulated Dragon
description: A beautifully detailed articulated dragon with movable joints. Each segment is precision-printed for smooth, satisfying movement. Available in multiple colors.

name: Geometric Planter
description: Modern geometric planter with a low-poly design. Perfect for succulents and small plants. Features a drainage hole and removable saucer.

name: Fidget Gear Cube
description: An interlocking gear cube that spins and rotates in all directions. A perfect desk toy for focus and relaxation. Printed as a single piece — no assembly required.

name: Flexi Rex
description: The classic flexible T-Rex! A fun, articulated dinosaur that can bend and pose. A crowd favourite at every exhibition. Great for kids and collectors alike.

name: Cable Organizer Set
description: Keep your desk tidy with these clip-on cable organizers. Set includes 5 clips in various sizes to hold different cable thicknesses. Adhesive backing included.

name: Hex Shelf Unit
description: Honeycomb-shaped wall shelf that can be combined in any pattern. Mount multiple units to create a unique wall display. Holds lightweight items and small plants.

name: Keychain Collection
description: A set of unique 3D printed keychains featuring geometric and pop-culture inspired designs. Lightweight, durable, and a great conversation starter.

name: Lithophane Photo Frame
description: Turn any photo into a stunning lithophane! When backlit, your photo appears in beautiful 3D relief. Custom-made from your image. A perfect personalised gift.

name: Mechanical Butterfly
description: A delicate mechanical butterfly with wing mechanisms that actually move. Wind-up mechanism allows the wings to flutter. A true showcase of 3D printing precision.

name: Desk Organizer Tower
description: Multi-tier rotating desk organizer with compartments for pens, clips, sticky notes, and more. The lazy-susan base allows 360° rotation for easy access.

name: Phone Amplifier Stand
description: Acoustic phone amplifier that boosts your phone's speaker volume naturally — no batteries or electronics needed. Works by channeling sound through a curved horn design.

name: Custom Name Plate
description: Personalised 3D name plate for your desk, door, or shelf. Choose your font style, color, and size. Makes a great gift or professional desk accessory.
